verdict.rationale: Supabase Storage is documented as a first-party file storage service with fine-grained access controls via row-level security and custom policies. It also claims optimized delivery, including on-the-fly image transformation served via signed and public URLs. missing for 10: explicit documentation of CDN-backed delivery (only 'optimized delivery' is stated), detailed upload API/flow evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of storage usage.
